effect_plane: Preserve three distinct facts: a request existed; an authority admitted/enforced it; an outcome was observed. None implies another.
Successful PostToolUse must never retroactively mint admission authority.
Pre-dispatch cancellation may close a PENDING_EFFECT as CANCELLED; after submission, transport uncertainty is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until verified and must not be blindly replayed.
Use immutable per-call identity end-to-end; session identity is context, not effect identity.
